caption: The drawing shows a rectangular jar or crock with a short, wide neck and two handles on either side of the shoulder. The container is illustrated using black lines on a plain beige or light tan background, and the details are outlined simply without any shading or color fill. Centered near the top of the jar are the words “WALL 3 PT LITTLE 124ST NEW YORK” written in an uppercase font. Below this text, there is a decorative floral pattern consisting of three stylized, downward-facing flowers arranged in a circular fashion, with curved petals and leaves also outlined in black. The overall composition is centered on the page, with significant blank space surrounding the drawing.
